_comment: Example MQTT mapping registry for the Perception Engine.  Point MQTT_MAPPINGS_FILE at this file (or set MQTT_MAPPINGS_JSON inline) to enable broker ingest.  Every rule maps one topic-filter pattern onto one perceptual-space region; capture groups in the wildcards are interpolated into sensorIdTemplate so wildcarded filters expand to many distinct sensors at runtime.

mappings._comment: JSON payload + MinMax normalization.  Topic 'sensors/zone/3/temp' captures '3' which becomes sensor id 'zone.3.temp'.
Plain CSV float, no transformation other than range clamp.
Multi-element payload — CSV with all three values mapped into a 3-wide region.  Length must match the transformed value count.
Boolean alarm flag — JSON pointer extracts the bool and normalize.linear scales (false→0, true→1).
Manual push — the value gets stored but no automatic push fires.  Use POST /api/push to batch with other slow-changing inputs.
